questions.q: What document does three-way matching add compared to two-way matching?
options: A second purchase order
A supplier bank account record
The receipt
A credit memo
questions.explain: Three-way matching compares the PO, the receipt, and the invoice -- adding the receipt as the third document.

questions.q: What question can three-way matching answer that two-way matching cannot?
options: Whether the goods billed for were actually received
Whether the supplier's tax ID is valid
Whether the invoice has the correct currency
Whether the PO was approved
questions.explain: Because it checks the receipt, three-way matching confirms that invoiced quantity doesn't exceed what has actually been received.

questions.q: In the Harbor Point Logistics example, 200 pallets are invoiced but only 180 have been received. What is the likely result?
options: The invoice validates normally because the price matched
A Quantity Received hold is placed on the invoice
The PO is automatically cancelled
The supplier is automatically blocked from future orders
questions.explain: Invoiced quantity exceeding received quantity triggers a Quantity Received hold under three-way matching.

questions.q: How does a held invoice like the Harbor Point example typically get resolved?
options: Only by manually overriding the hold with no further action
It cannot be resolved and must be cancelled
By switching the PO from three-way to two-way matching retroactively
By the remaining quantity being received (or the invoice corrected), after which it can revalidate
questions.explain: As additional receipts accumulate against the PO line, a previously held invoice can revalidate without being edited.

questions.q: For which kind of purchase is three-way matching the typical standard?
options: Purely intangible subscription services with no delivery
Physical goods such as parts, materials, or equipment
Petty cash reimbursements
Internal journal entries
questions.explain: Because physical goods can be ordered but never delivered, three-way matching's receipt check is the standard control for them.
